sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say that for floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges only for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and the separate in-force rule for existing floating-rate term loans applies only to loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025.

A home loan to an individual for a non-business purpose fits the borrower-and-purpose wording in those directions, but the stated sanction date of 31 December 2025 is neither before 31 December 2025 nor on or after 1 January 2026.
Because the evidence does not cover loans sanctioned on 31 December 2025, I cannot confirm that pre-payment charges are barred or permitted for this exact case from the cited directions alone.

missing.slot: coverage for floating-rate, non-business individual loans sanctioned on 31 December 2025
missing.searched: Checked the in-force UCB pre-payment charge directions for the dates before 31 December 2025 and on or after 1 January 2026; no cited rule explicitly covers 31 December 2025.
